newsitem.title: USA: Transco says Ala. natgas line leak cuts 700 mmcfd.
newsitem.headline: Transco says Ala. natgas line leak cuts 700 mmcfd.

text.p: Transcontinental Pipe Line Co (Transco) said Thursday a leak on its 30-inch diameter gas line in Mobile Bay, Alabama, cut about 700 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of gas supplies.
"We have totally isolated the lateral (line). We're still able to make deliveries on our main line. It's our offshore deliveries that are affected," said company spokesman Chris Stockton.
The company said it did not yet know the cause of the rupture, nor was it clear when the 104-mile line would be restored.
Pipeline crews, sent to the area when the leak was detected around midday, are investigating the cause of the leak, he said.
The leak was in Washington County, Ala. The line, which gathers gas from fields off Mobile Bay in the U.S. Gulf, runs ashore near Coden, Ala.
Transco is a subsidiary of The Williams Cos.
